topIssues.title: contracts-bedrock: bump OPCMv2 to v9 and retire previous allowances
topIssues.author: 0xOneTony
topIssues.body:
PR https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22805 makes ETHLockbox deployment available during v9 upgrades. OPCMv2 still reports 8.0.4, so the allowance stays disabled until the version bump. The pre-v9 startingAnchorRoot override also needs to be retired.

Definition of Done:
- Bump OPCMv2 to 9.0.0.
- Remove the < 9.0.0 branch that permits overrides.cfg.startingAnchorRoot.
- Update upgrade callers and fork setup to stop supplying that override. Use the chain’s existing anchor root.
- Keep ETHLockbox deployment permission restricted to v9.
- Run the missing-lockbox upgrade tests against the actual OPCM version instead of mocking v9. Keep the version-boundary tests.
- Test the v8 → v9 upgrade on a fork, including chains with an existing lockbox.

topPRs.title: CI-only: validate Kona SP1 tagged Docker builds
topPRs.author: Inphi
topPRs.body:
Temporary CI run for the Kona SP1 reproducibility work in #23090. This branch adds a job restricted to `chore/kona-sp1-validation` on the same native linux/amd64 `machine: true`, `large.gen2` class as the scheduled reproducibility job.

The job builds `kona-sp1-proposer/v0.0.5` twice in separate clean worktrees, compares each super-aggregation ELF vkey with its manifest, and compares the two build results. It then builds `v0.0.4` to measure sequential two-tag runtime, disk use, and output gaps. No registry entry or production workflow changes are intended. I will close this PR after recording the result.

topPRs.title: contracts-bedrock: Remove the startingAnchorRoot upgrade allowance
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Stacked on ethereum-optimism/optimism#22937. Merge that first.

An upgrade must not be able to rewrite a chain's anchor. That allowance existed only because our fork fixtures had no valid super-root anchor of their own, so a test convenience held open production authority over validated chain state.

The fixtures now reach the super-root state by replaying the deployed v8 OPCM, which supplies the anchor through `migrate`. Past upgrades keep the override, because earlier OPCM releases permitted it and a replay must stay faithful to what shipped.

Most of the diff is that fixture rework. The production change is the deleted allowance in `OPContractsManagerV2.sol`, plus the version bump the bytecode change requires. The upgrade tests lose their dual-mode branching, because the fixture arrives in a genuine super-root state, so the test file gets smaller.

ethereum-optimism/optimism#22937 is the precondition: it stops devstack overriding anchors, by deploying chains through OPCM so their genesis anchors are real.

Closes ethereum-optimism/optimism#22836

topPRs.title: op-reth: include pending flashblock logs in ranges
topPRs.author: joshklop
topPRs.body:
Ranges ending at `pending` currently stop at the canonical head, so `eth_getLogs` omits logs from OP's local pending flashblock. This restores the expected canonical-plus-pending result while preserving range/response limits and excluding stale-branch pending blocks.

Stacked on #23046 and pins [`ethereum-optimism/reth@1c51c30`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/reth/commit/1c51c3000e75b464f871a3b6c024245afdc405d8). Related review finding: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/23046#discussion_r4135197967

The full Reth update reviewer was not rerun because this PR contains one focused fix from the already-reviewed bump; the Rust implementation reviewer completed with no remaining findings.
